unit_scale.note: Style Lab ingredient forms are modelled in real centimetres and then multiplied by UNITS_PER_CM so the default 8 cm apple measures 2.095944 scene units (the size it has always had). The Kitchen composer works in centimetres throughout: pantry forms are converted back with inCm() (scale by 1/UNITS_PER_CM), and ware, glass, toast, fillets, pools and garnish are all authored in cm. There is no second hidden scale in the Kitchen — if a piece looks huge, its centimetre constants are wrong, not the unit mapping.

clamp.rule: Clamp every rendered piece to within ±15% of true_cm. Do not scale a piece up to fill a plate, or down to make a 3-ingredient plate look sparse. Size boards and plates from their contents (a finger's width / a rim's width of ware around the food). A toast stays ~11 x 8 x 1.7 cm; a salmon fillet on that toast must shrink to ribbons or flakes that fit the bread, never the other way around.
